label: AWS
author: Mike

slides.headline: Today it runs on [one PC]
slides.body: The graph and its checkpoints, {7} agents in Claude Code, one browser for images, Whisper on my GPU, the renders.

slides.headline: A gate longer than [a session]
slides.stat_sub: hours, my first gate's wait for me
slides.body: An AgentCore Runtime session lasts up to {8} hours. So the graph saves state to DynamoDB, and my approval resumes it in a new session.

slides.headline: No browser, [no lock]
slides.body: One browser was busy {3.9} hours of the build. On AWS, an image model on Bedrock, and the {7} shorts stop taking turns.

slides.headline: Does it run on [EC2]?
slides.stat_sub: max discount on EC2 Spot, {2}-minute warning
slides.body: Yes, but only the heavy work. AWS Batch starts servers when a job arrives, and every step skips what's done.

slides.headline: The renders [fan out]
slides.body: Remotion Lambda splits one render across up to {200} Lambda functions. Remotion's example: a {10}-minute HD video for around {10} cents.
